id: title:carlos-marchal-ph:strip nul from eval report content before storing

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a centralized utility to strip NUL bytes from nested data structures before storing in Postgres, preventing serialization errors when handling external inputs (ClickHouse, LLM, user input) or report content.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H1 introduces a shared utility `strip_null_bytes` in `posthog/models/utils.py` that recursively removes NUL bytes from strings, lists, tuples, and dicts. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement: it establishes a reusable safeguard against Postgres serialization failures caused by NUL bytes in stored JSON/text. review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation or all callers, so the full scope and test coverage are not fully demonstrated. The benefit relies on the assumption that NUL bytes are a realistic and unhandled risk in the described ingestion and storage paths.
